runs.label: v1 standard workflows
runs.python: Dedicated venv; PyTorch 2.14.0+cu130 and other existing packages referenced read-only from the developer's standard venv; ComfyUI 0.39 requirements (comfy-kitchen 0.2.37, comfy-aimdo 0.5.6, frontend/templates/docs) installed into the dedicated venv. The standard venv was unchanged.
runs.setup: setup.bat "COMFY_ROOT" --install-dependencies from a separate checkout of this repository; Python auto-detected (COMFY_ROOT\..\.venv); X2 Stream downloaded at eb148a3 and byte-identical to the measured code; package and sample image installed; 5 models found through extra_model_paths.yaml
runs.setup_fix: The first attempt exposed that an option in the second position was taken as the Python path; fixed in ebf0d33 before this run

compared_with_measured_runs.note: Video differs at the same level as run-to-run variation on ComfyUI 0.38

runs.timing_note: 5 s includes first model loading in a new process; not used for the README table
